agent_run_id.description: The run that produced this verification; the citation's `external_ref` and `origin_uri` are built from it.

baseline_document_identifier.description: An appointment/asset-scoped identifier for the client-issued baseline container.

baseline_provenance.description: Who issued the parsed pricing baseline. `client_issued` is the only clean value; `pca_internal` is a fallback that requires a warning finding.

line_items.description: The verified line items — the substance of the record and the only part the reader uses.

line_items[].item_ref.description: The client SoR item reference for a verified line.

line_items[].sor_qty.description: the line's own UoM (`line_items[].uom`, a string)

line_items[].tendered_comparison.matched.description: How the line was matched into the tendered submission.

line_items[].variance_pct.description: Server-computed variance of the measured value against the SoR quantity.

line_items[].verification_strength.description: How independent the corroborating derivation is.

opportunity_ref.description: The opportunity number/name the verified tender belongs to; the only human key that ties the fact to the spine entity it is anchored on.

pricing_document.description: The document the SoR line items were transcribed from. Null when no pricing document was parsed.

review_state.description: Every value on this shelf is agent-derived and awaits human reconciliation; the single legal value today.

revision_ordering_convention.description: A code-set identifier saying how to order revisions and status values (e.g. an annex or project execution-plan identifier).

status.description: The verification outcome for the run.

subject_entity_id.description: The opportunity spine entity the fact is anchored on. Recorded because it is the shelf's *only* axis: `entity_id=entity.id` with an empty `CoordinateBundle` (line 812), and there is no `project_id`/`period` column populated at all.

summary.description: One-paragraph rendered narrative (counts of consistent/discrepancy/unverified and number compared against the tendered submission).

tendered_document.revision.description: The revision label of the tendered submission, e.g. `Rev 3`; **not** an ordering or a status.
